<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will count the distinct peaks that fall in the typical aromatic carbon chemical shift range (approximately 110–160 ppm). This count corresponds to the number of aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
